arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK032. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Right-facing upright head at thin waterline. Tongue is tall and curled UP in front of the near cheek/snout, almost vertical below the eye, its base connected to mouth. Preserve this cheek-licking phase, closed/narrow grin and one wide visible eye with pupil. Do not replace the tall tongue with a short mouth patch. No hidden body/tail. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
